faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about palm reading

questions.question: How accurate is AI palm reading?
questions.answer: Our AI system achieves 95% accuracy by combining traditional palmistry knowledge with advanced machine learning algorithms trained on thousands of palm readings.

questions.question: What kind of photo should I upload?
questions.answer: Take a clear photo of your palm in good lighting with fingers slightly spread. Show your entire palm from wrist to fingertips. Both indoor and outdoor lighting work well.

questions.question: How long does the analysis take?
questions.answer: Our AI processes your palm reading in under 2 minutes. You'll receive your detailed report immediately after the analysis is complete.

questions.question: Is my data secure and private?
questions.answer: Yes, absolutely. We use enterprise-grade encryption, your photos are automatically deleted after analysis, and we never share your personal information.

questions.question: Can I get multiple readings?
questions.answer: Yes! You can get readings for both hands or update your reading as your life changes. Premium packages include unlimited readings.

questions.question: Do you offer refunds?
questions.answer: Yes, we offer a 30-day money-back guarantee. If you're not satisfied with your reading, contact our support team for a full refund.
